question_no.description: Number of the question whose answer you are scoring

score.description: 0-10, using the rubric in your instructions

strengths.description: 1-3 specific things the answer did well (may be empty for a non-answer)

weaknesses.description: 1-3 specific gaps or mistakes (may be empty for an excellent answer)

model_answer.description: What a strong candidate would say, 80-200 words
